448597.overview:
Into Ruins is a procedurally-generated roguelike for the PICO-8. It is a multi-cart game spanning two cartridges.

Reach depth 16 and retrieve the Wings of Yendor.

450648.overview:
A "platformer" without platforms where you play as a bird trying to find someplace to land, originally made for the 2018 GMTK Game Jam!  Instead of jumping from platform to platform, you flap your wings to effectively jump in the air.  In this flap'em up, you can also choose which direction you propel yourself by aiming.

This game got featured at PAX East 2019 at WPI's Interactive Media and Game Development Booth!

450869.overview:
Once up on a time there was a coffee lover.

This coffee loving blob is out of coffee and the factory seems to be down.
No one else seems willing to fix it so it is up to you to restore it.

After all, coffee is the fuel for the people.

451977.overview: iii is a little "catroidvania" about a one-eyed cat leaving his comfort zone. Explore underground caverns, gain vision of other dimensions, help the inhabitants, and expand your horizons. iii was originally made by Yukon W. for Ludum Dare 38. This is a PICO-8 Demake made with his permission.

452878.overview: Icefall is a run and gun shooter for Pico-8.

452896.overview:
What a beautiful summer day! The sun is warm, the sea is calm... pity there's all those monst... er... little kids running around like the beach belongs to them. Oh, but you have something they want: ICE CREAM! It's going to be a PROFITABLE DAY! 

Just try not to piss them off...

A game made for Ludum Dare 53, theme "Delivery". You are delivering ice creams, obviously. 

HOW TO PLAY
- Turn your music ON with Z to lure clients.
- Drive your truck (arrow keys) near kids, wait for them to ask for an ice cream.
- Use X to prepare an icecream.
- PROFIT!

TIPS
- Be quick. If ice cream take too long kids will get mad*.
- Just don't run over kids, it's bad for business. And they get mad*.
